# Sri Sanjeevi Mini Hall A/C

> A fully air-conditioned hall for up to 300 guests, with an A/C dining hall, 4 A/C rooms and a temple on the premises, easy to reach from Tambaram station.

Website: https://sanjeevihall.com/

## Facilities
- Fully air-conditioned hall
- A/C dining hall
- Lift + extra dining elevator
- Complete power back-up
- 4 A/C rooms
- 24-hr CCTV
- Temple within premises
- Indoor & outdoor parking
- Acoustically optimised

## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can Sri Sanjeevi Mini Hall A/C hold?
Sri Sanjeevi Mini Hall hosts up to 300 guests in its fully air-conditioned hall.

### Where is Sri Sanjeevi Mini Hall A/C?
414, Mudichur Road, Tambaram, Chennai 600 045 (Easily reached from Tambaram railway station).

### What facilities does Sri Sanjeevi Mini Hall A/C have?
Fully air-conditioned hall, A/C dining hall, Lift + extra dining elevator, Complete power back-up, 4 A/C rooms, 24-hr CCTV, Temple within premises, Indoor & outdoor parking, Acoustically optimised.

### Is there a temple at the hall?
Yes, there is a temple within the premises.

### Are rooms available?
Yes, 4 fully furnished A/C rooms.

### How do I check if Sri Sanjeevi Mini Hall A/C is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 99403 09239.
